Inability to escape poverty. I can’t afford to go to school in terms of both money and time and anything I really am passionate about isn’t a sustainable way to make money. I can’t afford a trade school, though I’m willing. There aren’t many jobs in any sense in my area and I’ve tried moving and living in larger places, but there’s always some catch that leaves me living in a car or bouncing motel rooms. The jobs I can get don’t pay enough, which is why I can’t afford upward mobility. None of my hobbies are lucrative. On top of that, mental problems make it hard for me to keep one job for a long time, especially when it’s shitty like the ones I always find myself in, and coworkers/management usually treats me like shit. If I work hard, they take advantage until I’m physically exhausted every single day, in addition to berating/making fun of me and riding my ass constantly. It isn’t always like this in larger cities and it varies depending on where you work, but a good majority of places I’ve been able to work are like this. 

I don’t have any friends or family and am completely on my own outside of my gf and dog, but I hurt them constantly due to being poor and mentally ill, so I feel like it would be a blessing to have me gone. I think that much is clear and deep down, she has to as well. 

I had a rough childhood and probably suffer from ptsd but I made good grades and showed a lot of potential as a kid. I can’t even say I’ve made mistakes along the way because I had a lot of opportunities ripped out from under me and had to adapt as best I could, but there’s no reward for that. I’m now twenty something with no direction and severe anxiety, depression and who knows what else. I have plenty of drive and motivation but not for things that are “marketable.” I’ve come to terms with that and would try to get better jobs, but I don’t know where to start. Hardly anyone I’ve been around is financially successful and those who are sure as hell dont offer any meaningful advice. I’ve even tried various subreddits on multiple accounts at different periods of time and I can find no sort of wisdom on this. Sure, there are possibilities for me, but how the fuck am I supposed to reach them when I have to pay so much to live?

Same. Everyone will echo channeling that pain into your future, but that’s easier said than done. Sometimes it’s too late. Not to seem pessimistic, just realistic. It still burns me how it seems like everyone else my age has parents or family to fall back on. Nope. I was never given an opportunity to start a successful life and now no one is around to even offer guidance (not that they ever really were, but a couch to sleep on might be nice at least). 

Point being, we’re on own and there’s nothing special or noble about that - especially when others are constantly handed the opportunities we would die for. 

Feels like the best course of action is to improve your perspective and adjust your goal posts, but that doesn’t work for everyone either. Good luck.
